The conference is also an occasion to associate scientific research with raising the training quality and enhancing cooperation among universities, colleges, research institutes, provincial/municipal Services of Natural Resources and Environment, Services of Agriculture and Rural Development and units and enterprises. The Organizing Committee of the Workshop would like to send a notice to scientists, managers, relevant organizations, alumni, graduate students and graduate students in Land Science and Land Management and relevant disciplines. The full text of the Conference will be critically reviewed and published in the Soil Science Journal.

Drill and describe the soil profile,

Parsimony analysis, density, density, soil moisture,

Analysis of mineral components in soil, soil hypogeus,

Chemistry:

pH, EC, CEC, CEC exchange rate,

Analysis of exchange cations such as Ca, Mg, K, Na, Al

Factor N total, useful NH4+, NO3-.

Total and useful P analysis and many other P - components in soil

Organic matter analysis, humic acid, and fulvic acid

Trace and heavy metal analysis in total and exchange forms, organic bonding

Phòng thí nghiệm GIS – Viễn thám có chức: The GIS – Remote Sensing Laboratory serves undergraduate and postgraduate teaching of subjects in Land Management, Forestry, Environmental Resources Management, Climate Change and Delta Management. In addition, the GIS - Remote Sensing Laboratory is a place for domestic and international scientific research and researches in the GIS, remote sensing, UAVs, cartography and other geodesic - related fields.
Phòng thí nghiệm Tài nguyên Đất đai có c: The Land Resource Laboratories function to serve the tertiary and postgraduate teaching of subjects in the specialized branches of Land Management, Bio-forestry, Soil Sciences, Horticulture, Agronomy, Rural Development, etc. , in service of the analysis and evaluation of the norms on soil, water, fertilizer and plant physicochemistry for students and graduates.

The Land Resource Laboratories function to serve the tertiary and postgraduate teaching of subjects in the specialized branches of Land Management, Bio-forestry, Soil Sciences, Horticulture, Agronomy, Rural Development, etc. , in service of the analysis and evaluation of the norms on soil, water, fertilizer and plant physicochemistry for students and graduates.

Besides, the Land Resources Laboratory shall also be the place where scientific researches are carried out, serving the school-level and local scientific researches and international cooperation of the Land Resources Department and the Department of Environment and Youth Environment.

Along with scientific research activities, the laboratory is also the place for organizing specialized training courses and forums for intensive discussion on land management, soil science, soil and water environment in the Mekong Delta.
Phòng thí nghiệm “GIS&Viễn thám” được th: The laboratory "GIS&Resonance" was established to provide intensive teaching and research in the fields related to the application of remote sensing images and spatial analysis, measurement and mapping in the management of environmental resources. It also serves as a place for the development of ideas of cadres and students in the field of remote sensing-space analysis, cartography in service of land management, exploitation and management of land and environmental resources.

Trong hai ngày 17–18/7/2026, tại Học việ: On July 17 - 18, 2026, at the Vietnam Academy of Agriculture (Hanoi), the IVth National Land Management Science Workshop on "Land Resource Access in the Digital Era" took place. This is the prestigious annual scientific forum of the land management industry, which was co-founded and alternately organized by the Vietnam Academy of Agriculture, the Agricultural and Forestry University of Hue University and Can Tho University to create a forum for academic exchange, sharing research results and proposing scientific solutions for land management and use in the new development context of the country.
Trong khuôn khổ chương trình, sinh viên: As part of the program, students have participated in diverse activities, combining study, fieldwork, visits, and exchanges with instructors and students in Thailand. Through activities at the university, urban parks, historical areas, urban spaces and field survey sites in Bangkok, students have the opportunity to observe and learn how space organization, natural resources - environmental management and urban development are organized in a different context of natural, socio - economic and cultural conditions.
Trong khuôn khổ hợp tác giữa Bộ môn Tài: In the framework of cooperation between the Department of Land Resources, Department of Environment and Natural Resources, Can Tho University, Vietnam and the Department of Geography, Department of Social Sciences, Srinakharinwirot University, Thailand, the 3rd International Conference on Geoinformatics for Sustainable Development (ICGGS 2023) was held at the 4th floor, Learning Materials Center, Can Tho University, from November 30 - December 2, 2023. Yêu cầu nâng cao kiến thức chuyên môn củ: - The demand for raising the professional knowledge of local officials has become larger and greater; Particularly in the fields of policies on economic restructuring and consumption of agricultural products, agricultural-forestry-fishery production, the land use situation has seen quite marked changes along the direction of production diversification and specialization. This transformation has affected the process of management and exploitation of land resources, requiring local officials to regularly update and correct land changes and apply scientific, technical and technological advances so as to be able to quickly and efficiently settle land management-related matters. Therefore, a higher education in Land Management is necessary at the present time. The training of master's degree in Land Management will contribute significantly to the strategy of developing and improving the level of human resources for the country in general and the Mekong Delta in particular, as well as to the needs and speed of development of urban and rural areas, requiring post-graduate cadres to support the land management at present and in the future.
